findings.evidenceJa: ライダーがすぐさま倒された
findings.governingReading: Rider was promptly defeated
findings.explanation: The report establishes defeat, while the English states Rider’s death.

findings.evidenceJa: 貧血程度で生活に支障はない
findings.governingReading: most students have only anemia, with no impairment to daily life
findings.explanation: The practical limit on most students’ injuries disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 人並み外れて体力のある人
findings.governingReading: she has stamina far beyond an ordinary person
findings.explanation: Taiga’s physical robustness becomes vague “energy.”

findings.evidenceJa: キャスターの魔術
findings.governingReading: Caster’s magecraft
findings.explanation: Saber’s inability to block Caster’s magecraft is generalized to magic.

findings.evidenceJa: 魔術の感知
findings.governingReading: Magecraft is easier to detect
findings.explanation: A technical detection claim again collapses magecraft into magic.

findings.evidenceJa: 白玉あんみつチョコ饅頭なみに甘い
findings.governingReading: You are as naive as that shiratama-anmitsu chocolate bun dessert was sweet!
findings.explanation: The imagined Saber line’s elaborate double meaning between naivety and dessert sweetness disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: ド外道
findings.governingReading: an utter scoundrel / monster
findings.explanation: Saber’s imagined moral abuse of Caster becomes an unrelated religious category.

findings.evidenceJa: 性根の捻れ曲がった野郎
findings.governingReading: a bastard twisted to the core
findings.explanation: The imagined insult loses its aggression and judgment of Archer’s innermost nature.

findings.evidenceJa: 一刀両断されそう
findings.governingReading: she would cut my argument cleanly in two
findings.explanation: The sword metaphor linking Saber’s rebuke to her fighting style disappears.

findings.highlight: please do not run away to the shed, okay!?
findings.evidenceJa: 夜な夜な土蔵などに逃げ出さぬように
findings.governingReading: See that you do not flee to the shed night after night!
findings.explanation: Saber’s absolute command and repeated-night framing become a polite request.

findings.highlight: anticipated that I was going to run away
findings.evidenceJa: 見抜かれてる
findings.governingReading: has seen straight through my plan to flee
findings.explanation: Saber’s perceptiveness is weakened to prediction.

findings.highlight: you can surprise attack the enemy
findings.evidenceJa: 油断して襲ってきた敵を撃退できる
findings.governingReading: you can repel an enemy who attacks after letting down its guard
findings.explanation: Saber’s defensive counterattack becomes her initiating a surprise attack.

findings.evidenceJa: 物理的に眠れない
findings.governingReading: It would be physically impossible to sleep
findings.explanation: Shirou means shared sleep is psychologically or practically impossible, not that two bodies cannot fit.

findings.evidenceJa: 今夜はやけに弁が立ちますね
findings.governingReading: You are unusually persuasive tonight
findings.explanation: Saber’s recognition of Shirou’s argumentative fluency becomes humor or cleverness.

findings.highlight: trained with Saber until eleven and spent an hour doing my routine in the shed
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーとの剣の鍛錬を十一時までこなして、土蔵での日課を一時間
findings.governingReading: I complete sword training with Saber until eleven, then one hour of my separate daily routine in the shed
findings.explanation: The English syntax blurs two distinct training routines and their sequence.

findings.highlight: Man, I can’t sleep that easily.
findings.evidenceJa: そう簡単に眠れるか、ばか
findings.governingReading: Like I could fall asleep that easily, idiot
findings.explanation: Shirou’s comic self-directed insult disappears.

findings.highlight: That causes my restless mind to stop.
findings.evidenceJa: うわついた心などふっとんだ
findings.governingReading: my flighty mood is blown clean away
findings.explanation: A sudden emotional reset becomes the mind itself stopping.

findings.highlight: She was desperately bearing all of it
findings.evidenceJa: あいつは必死に堪えていた
findings.governingReading: Rin was desperately holding herself together
findings.explanation: Rin’s effort to contain her own reaction becomes bearing Rider and the students as objects.

findings.highlight: I figured out the deep part of her
findings.evidenceJa: あいつの深いところを知った
findings.governingReading: I caught a glimpse of something deep within her
findings.explanation: A momentary intimate perception becomes an awkward claim of analytical solution.

findings.evidenceJa: 気丈で、したたかで
findings.governingReading: brave-hearted and shrewd
findings.explanation: Rin’s distinct courage and worldly shrewdness collapse into overlapping firmness.

findings.highlight: The more she tries to act as a magus
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術師としての自分を貫けば貫くほど
findings.governingReading: The more thoroughly she remains true to herself as a magus
findings.explanation: Rin’s strenuous adherence to an identity becomes mere performance.

findings.highlight: the more she kills her true self as Tohsaka Rin
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂凛という自分を端っこに追い込んでいる
findings.governingReading: the more she drives the self called Tohsaka Rin into a corner
findings.explanation: Ongoing self-suppression is escalated into destruction of a separate “true self.”

findings.evidenceJa: あれだけやる事にそつがないヤツ
findings.governingReading: someone so unfailingly competent in everything she does
findings.explanation: Shirou admires Rin’s practical competence; the English idealizes her as globally perfect.

findings.highlight: I want to be a support
findings.evidenceJa: 少しぐらいは支えになってやりたい
findings.governingReading: I want to support her at least a little
findings.explanation: The modest, embarrassed scale of Shirou’s desire disappears into awkward abstraction.
